name: Voracious Bibliophile
oracle_text:
Flying, vigilance
Whenever you cast a spell with one or more targets, draw that many cards.
blocked_sentences: Whenever you cast a spell with one or more targets, draw that many cards.

needs.what: a spell_cast trigger filter key matching a spell that has one or more targets chosen as it was cast (e.g. filter {"has_targets": true}), counting distinct target objects/players across all its target instances
needs.why_existing_wont_do: trigger_filter_keys reads only printed characteristics (types, colors, mana_value, ...) and zone/controller facts; nothing inspects the cast spell's chosen targets. targeted_by on a trigger is the inverse (a permanent becoming the target), and becomes_target fires per targeted object, not once per spell cast

needs.what: a value reading the number of targets the triggering spell (bound as the trigger's subject) has, so draw's amount can be 'that many'
needs.why_existing_wont_do: value_keys has count over a selector, x, mana_value_of and spells_cast_this_turn, but no reader of a stack object's chosen targets; the engine's target_count helper in engine/targeting.py computes legal target numbers for a spec, not the targets a cast spell actually chose, and is not exposed to the DSL
